0022600103.text: The Kings (0-1, 14th in the West, 4th in the Pacific and 1 game back) host the Trail Blazers (1-0, 2nd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, 4th in the West). Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision, while Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Sacramento lost all four meetings with Portland in 2025-26, most recently 122-110 in Portland on April 12, 2026.
